purpose: Evidence for the plan review in docs/PLAN_REVIEW.md. Every claim the review overturns was measured here.

probes.claim_tested: PROJECT_PLAN v1 8.2/8.3: historical way geometry needs one API call per node, so branch B1 cannot run on Corpus A
probes.note: Versioned multi-fetch works. Up to 725 versioned element ids per request, so previous states batch instead of costing one call each.

probes.claim_tested: same as P1, second independent route
probes.verdict: FALSE - geometry is directly available for 2013 onward
probes.note: adiff returns BEFORE and AFTER with node coordinates already resolved on the way. This is the full-strength B1 input for the Ovid era.

probes.claim_tested: per-changeset adiff is workable (bbox + [created_at, closed_at] window, filter by changeset id)
probes.note: [bbox:...] in the setting block errors with adiff; put the bbox on each statement instead.

probes.claim_tested: PROJECT_PLAN v1 7: current OSM data is reachable only through the API or Overpass, one changeset at a time
probes.note: Both streams are live to the current minute. Bulk, free, no account. This is how the project gets genuinely latest OSM data.

probes.claim_tested: changeset replication payload is rich enough for metadata + revert mining
probes.note: One ~3 KB gz per minute. A month of changeset metadata is ~125 MB gz - trivially affordable, and it removes the need to download the 8.7 GB dump for recent windows.

probes.claim_tested: PROJECT_PLAN v1 8.2: OSM API changeset download takes ~0.2 s
probes.verdict: FALSE - the plan text contradicts its own results file
probes.note: 1.2 s is the right planning number, and tail latency reaches 8 s. Fetch budgets in the plan must be rebuilt on 1.2 s, not 0.2 s.

probes.claim_tested: real-changesets bucket is dense across its 147M-164M window (Gate 0c pinned bounds but never density)
probes.verdict: CONFIRMED - 82%, consistent with OSM's empty-changeset rate
probes.note: No systematic hole. ~14M usable changesets. Corpus B and C are viable.

probes.claim_tested: OSMCha API is readable without a token
probes.verdict: FALSE - token required, as the plan says
probes.note: Confirms Decision 5 is a real blocker for the OSMCha label route.

probes.claim_tested: sizes of the bulk artefacts the plan depends on
probes.note: Changeset dump is 8.72 GB, not the 8.1 GB in the plan. Full-history planet at 162 GB is out of reach on free tiers - confirming that adiff/multi-fetch, not the history PBF, is the geometry route.
